notes.title: Patch Note May 23, 2025
notes.content:
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Added tutorial feature
[*] Added 3 advanced characters
[*] Added a few melee and ranged weapons
[*] Added 5 new levels
[*] Added airdrop supply box events within levels
[*] Added training animations for some characters
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Note April 25, 2025
notes.content:
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new levels
[*] Added 1 advanced character
[*] Added Black Market, where players can trade food for equipment
[*] Added unique idle animations to characters in the character attribute page
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Drastically increased the amount of XP, the quality of weapons and the chance to get drinks provided by Elites and Bosses
[*] Fixed the bug that caused the attack range to differ from what it actually is
[*] Optimized the framerate of certain levels
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note April 18, 2025
notes.content:
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the 5th and 6th levels
[*] Added training animations for some characters
[*] Added the function to view character attributes
[*] Added 4 new characters
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the experience of levels 1-4
[*] Adjusted the initial character to Maid with healing abilities
[*] Optimized weapon performance and ammunition consumption
[/list]
